# Final Execution Tranche — Every-Page Continuation

The Awtsmoos renews the whole city one truthful street at a time; Awtsmoos.com will be measured, repaired, reread, tested, and only then called bright.

## Tranche A — Close Existing Sefarim Work

- Readback current rewritten entry/active-search/test contract.
- Enforce <=120 line source/test modules.
- Run presentation contract, search mode, full Sefarim suite with direct exit propagation.
- Browser test query route at desktop/tablet/430px/short-height.
- Inspect console/network/overflow/focus/context/search options.
- Measure cold/warm timing and resource inventory.

## Tranche B — Sitewide Discovery

- Harvest actual public-route census.
- Run existing runtime-quality crawler against complete public route registry.
- Merge current Git/mission ownership.
- Generate ranked route-debt ledger.

## Tranche C — Rolling Repairs

For each highest-impact clean/unclaimed route family:
1. Read complete owner graph.
2. Write family-specific plan delta.
3. Rewrite complete small source files.
4. Reread every changed file.
5. Run focused tests.
6. Browser-test interactions/layout.
7. Measure loading.
8. Rerun sitewide matrix.
9. Continue.

## Tranche D — Compact/Performance Infrastructure

Trace actual `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer` compact implementation; benchmark representative JS/CSS normal vs compact; adopt only measured safe gains. Preserve readable source.

## Tranche E — Release

Full repository secret/risk scan, Git topology, all safe requested unrelated changes staged and committed, push to GitHub, actual deploy, production smoke/performance, final delta and follow-up push if required.

## Completion Gate

No completion claim until the actionable public-route ledger is empty or remaining items are externally blocked, tests/browser/performance gates pass, the complete safe snapshot is on GitHub, deployment uses that snapshot, and production smoke evidence agrees.

## NEXT_ACTION

Observe the currently running Sefarim verification, audit-entry inspection, route census, Chrome status, mission plan, and Git census; then execute the first resulting safe action immediately.
